title: Monarch reel 01 — example
notes: Copy into workflows/current/payload/, put the Monarch reference crops in assets/refs/, record the line in assets/vo/line1.wav, then plan -> render -> verify -> assemble.

shots.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the man in <Picture 1>-<Picture 3>: late-20s South Asian man, thick swept-back black hair with volume at the crown, long side locks in front of the ears, light beard along the jaw, straight nose with a slightly dropped tip, fitted black shirt with the top button open and a charcoal blazer. <Picture 1> front hero, <Picture 2> three-quarter, <Picture 3> right profile. <Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1>.

summary:
[single character, direct address] A 5-second 9:16 shot of <Subject 1> in a charcoal studio, soft key from upper-left with teal and amber rims, one calm confident line to camera.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - same face, hair volume, side locks, beard line and wardrobe; only expression and head angle change.
<Audio 1>: reference - the target speech follows the timbre and pacing of <Audio 1>.

detailed_description:
The target video is in realistic photographic style, vertical 9:16 framing.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up against a charcoal backdrop with a teal rim on his left shoulder and a warm amber edge on his right. He holds eye contact with the lens, inhales once, and speaks with a low, assured voice (S1), <d>[English] I built this studio in one night.</d> The corner of his mouth lifts into a slow confident smirk. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet studio room tone with a very low air-conditioning hum.

non_diegetic_music:
A sparse detuned 808 sub under a muted cello note, fading to silence on the smirk.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic live-action, a slow vertical push through a rain-wet alley at night, one flickering amber neon sign, steam rising from a storm drain, a lone figure in a charcoal coat walking away, their shadow stretching along the wet stones. The camera tracks the figure with small amplitude at slow speed. Cold teal shadows, warm amber highlights, heavy film grain, the lower third of the frame stays empty dark space.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain on metal awnings, a distant tram bell, footsteps in shallow water.

non_diegetic_music: Solo muted trumpet over a sustained low string drone, slow tempo.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG render, macro shot of a matte black object rotating on a reflective obsidian plinth, a single hard key light sweeping its machined edge, dust motes in the beam, a teal gradient blooming behind it. The camera arcs around the object with small amplitude at slow speed. The lower third of the frame stays empty dark space.

overall_soundscape: A deep sub-bass swell, a metallic click as the object locks into place.

non_diegetic_music: Minimal electronic pulse at 90 BPM, one filtered saw chord opening at the cut.
